_doc: Gameplay-critical rows of the critical sheets whose verification cell says unverified, each acknowledged by a hash of the whole row. tools/package.py refuses a release while preflight.critical_unacked lists one (a row that is new, or changed after it was acknowledged): a number that may differ from CS2 then ships as a decision someone made, not as a count. Review the rows python3 tools/preflight.py --critical lists, then python3 tools/preflight.py --ack records them.
